annotation.title_clean: Perkuat Pengambilan Kebijakan Berbasis Data, Pemerintah Manfaatkan Kecerdasan Buatan
annotation.title_en: Strengthening Data-Based Policymaking, Government Utilizes Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Kementerian Koordinator Bidang Perekonomian Republik Indonesia
annotation.summary_en: Indonesian Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs press release on the kick-off of the AI GARUDA training and webinar on AI for data-driven economic policy. It cites the National AI Strategy 2020-2045 and stresses AI for technological sovereignty and economic growth. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Government reaffirms National AI Strategy 2020-2045 (ethics and policy, talent, infrastructure and data, research and innovation).
AI GARUDA training launched for ministries, universities and students (about 1,539 participants).
AI framed as strengthening technological sovereignty and national resilience.
Cites projections of AI's economic contribution globally and in Indonesia.
